programExecution.disableTooltip: Stop analysing and simulating this program, to write free text in it
programExecution.enableTooltip: The analyser of this program is disabled: it is neither analysed nor simulated
programExecution.noticeBody: This program can no longer be simulated, and its expressions are no longer validated. It can still be drawn, edited and exported to PDF.
programExecution.noticeFreeText: You can therefore write sentences in it rather than logical expressions, for example to describe a grafcet in plain language. Its step (Xn) and block variables do not exist for the other programs.
programExecution.noticeEnable: To enable the analyser again: "Enable analyser" button in the toolbar, or right-click the program in the explorer.
programExecution.notExecutedBody: The analyser of this program has been disabled: its expressions are not validated and it is neither compiled nor simulated. None of its steps becomes active and it drives no output.
programExecution.notExecutedEnable: To enable it again, stop the simulation, then click "Enable analyser" in the program's toolbar.
